result.summary: The home screen is largely well laid out, with one clear content defect: the discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−0%', which is a meaningless promotional value. The partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The promo badge on the second restaurant card under 'Popular right now' (the pizza card) shows '−0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests a missing or uncomputed discount value being rendered instead of the badge being hidden.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero or undefined, and check the data binding or formatting so the real percentage (e.g. '−20%') is shown when a promotion exists.
